question: In all of the following enzyme deficiencies, hyperammonemia is a common feature, EXCEPT:
analysis: Ornithine amino transferase deficiency does not typically lead to hyperammonemia, as it primarily affects the urea cycle indirectly. In contrast, deficiencies in argininosuccinate synthetase, carbamoyl phosphate synthetase (CPS-I), and ornithine transcarbamoylase (OTC) directly disrupt the urea cycle, leading to elevated ammonia levels.
